title: Recover a Flow

request.details: {{route:cards.recovery_basis}} for restart or {{route:cards.node_basis}} for a card retry. POST to {{route:cards.restart}} or {{route:cards.retry}} with a new request_id and the unchanged expected_context. Reuse both on transport retry.

response: Distinguish new_attempt, existing_attempt and group_head. A new card attempt uses predecessor results or the inspected group HEAD. Use actual_basis for materialized input. If restart is pending while stopping, send the same request again to continue.
errors: On changed context or a conflicting request_id, refresh the basis. Check the error reason for holds, gates or required merges.
